entry.title: BILL033(26) (Honolulu): CR-216(26) Reported out for passage on third reading as amended in CD2 form.
entry.content:
RELATING TO FUNDS.

Establishes a special fund to be called the Parks Maintenance and Recreation Services Special Fund for the deposit of all revenues and proceeds generated by the DPR relating to the use of lands dedicated for park use or for park maintenance and recreation services, or otherwise earmarked for the restoration, operation, or maintenance of beaches and parks under the jurisdiction of the DPR, to be expended for DPR operations, parks maintenance and recreational facilities, and programs under the jurisdiction of the DPR. Establishes a special fund to be called the Botanical Gardens and Urban Forestry Special Fund for the deposit of all revenues and proceeds relating to the use of lands dedicated for botanical gardens, community gardens, and urban forestry programs and operations generated by the DPR, or otherwise earmarked for the restoration, operation, or maintenance of gardens and park and street trees under the jurisdiction of the DPR, to be expended for the operations of the DPR's Division of Urban Forestry a

Latest action: CR-216(26) Reported out for passage on third reading as amended in CD2 form.
